identificationModule.officialTitle: A Prospective Clinical Study of "Selinexor+Pegaspargase+Dexamethasone" in the Treatment of Stage Ⅰ/Ⅱ NK/ T-Cell Lymphoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: evaluate the efficacy and safety of "Selinexor+pegaspargase+dexamethasone" in early stage NK/ T-cell lymphoma
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Patients with early NK/T cell lymphoma were treated with an oral regimen of \"Selinisol + pemaspartase + dexamethasone\"

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: Climbing stage, and the following two stages of research

armGroups.label: Selinexor+pegaspargase+dexamethasone
armGroups.description: Nuclear export protein-1 is the main transporter protein for leucine-rich proteins to enter the cytoplasm from the nucleus through the nuclear pore complex, which is overexpressed in malignant tumor cells. Studies have shown that Selinexor inhibits the nuclear export of viral mRNA such as EBV, and has good therapeutic potential for NKTCL. Selinexor combined with pemaspartase, dexamethasone and sequential radiotherapy may be the golden choice for early NK/T cell lymphoma, improving the local control rate of the disease and improving the overall prognosis of NK/T cell lymphoma.
